analysing: Adds damage against armored targets (up to +5/level); 10% chance/level for 1 mining XP.
对有护甲的目标增加伤害（每级最多+5）；有效采掘每级有10%概率额外获得1点经验。
arcane: +1 upgrade slot per level. Ability slots are unchanged.
berserk: Up to +40% melee damage/level as your health falls.
生命越低近战伤害越高，每级最多增加40%。
blind: Fully charged melee hits have a 15% chance/level to blind for 3 seconds.
满蓄力近战每级有15%概率使目标失明3秒。
bright: +20% mining speed/level and night vision while held in bright areas.
在明亮区域手持时获得夜视，采掘速度每级增加20%。
cascade: Consecutive effective blocks within 3 seconds build up to +30% mining speed/level.
连续有效采掘可叠加速度；间隔超过3秒重置，每级最多增加30%。
catcher: Fully charged melee hits slow the target for 2 seconds +1/level.
满蓄力近战使目标缓慢，持续2秒加每级1秒。
congenial: 生命值至少90%时，近战伤害每级增加15%。
crushing: +20% melee damage/level against healthy targets; mining has a 10% chance/level (max 50%) of bonus raw ore.
对生命至少80%的目标每级增伤20%；采掘原矿每级有10%概率增产（概率最高50%）。
cursed: Fully charged melee hits have a 5% chance to weaken the wielder for 3 seconds.
满蓄力近战有5%概率使自身虚弱3秒。
curvature: 对末影人的近战伤害每级增加30%。
dark: +20% mining speed/level and night vision while held in dark areas.
在黑暗区域手持时获得夜视，采掘速度每级增加20%。
decay: Fully charged melee hits have a 15% chance/level to wither for 3 seconds.
满蓄力近战每级有15%概率使目标凋零3秒。
diffuse: +50% mob XP, but each generated item drop has a 35% chance to disappear.
生物经验增加50%，但每组生成的物品掉落有35%概率消失。
dissolving: Mob XP randomly becomes 0x, 1x, 2x, 3x or 4x (equal chances; cap 10000).
生物经验以相同概率变为0、1、2、3或4倍，单次上限10000。
fracture: Wear grants up to +20% melee damage and +25% mining speed per level.
工具磨损越重越强；每级最多增加20%近战伤害和25%采掘速度。
fragile: -15% durability and +1 damage/level; use may cost one extra durability.
每级耐久降低15%、伤害增加1；使用时可能额外消耗1点耐久。
garishly: 对免疫火焰的目标，近战伤害每级增加20%。
glimmer: Fully charged hits reveal targets; effective mining grants 12 seconds of night vision.
满蓄力近战使目标发光；有效采掘获得12秒夜视。
heroic: 对敌对怪物的近战伤害每级增加15%。
hollow: 每级耐久降低20%，攻击速度增加15%。
melting: Fully charged hits ignite targets; 20% chance/level to smelt generated drops.
满蓄力近战点燃目标；每级有20%概率将掉落物转为熔炉产物。
mutate: Fully charged hits have a 20% chance/level of poison or weakness for 4 seconds.
满蓄力近战每级有20%概率给予目标4秒中毒或虚弱。
naturebound: While held over soil or logs, repairs 1 durability/level every 2 seconds.
站在泥土类方块或原木上手持时，每2秒每级修复1点耐久。
ported: Sneak-right-click teleports up to 10 blocks to a safe landing; costs 20 durability, 10 second cooldown by default.
潜行右键传送到前方10格内的安全落点，消耗20耐久，默认冷却10秒。
pulverizing: Crushes cobblestone/deepslate drops to gravel and gravel drops to sand.
将圆石、深板岩圆石掉落粉碎成沙砾，将沙砾掉落粉碎成沙子。
resonance: +0.15 knockback/level; charged melee hits grant 2 seconds of Resistance I.
每级击退增加0.15；满蓄力近战获得2秒抗性提升I。
reviving: Direct melee kills of hostile monsters heal 2 health and repair 1% durability/level.
直接近战击杀敌对怪物时，每级恢复2点生命并修复1%耐久。
softy: -10% melee damage and +10% mining speed per level.
每级近战伤害降低10%，采掘速度增加10%。
souleater: Direct melee monster kills grant permanent damage based on max health. Default cap +20/level; progress stays with the tool.
直接近战击杀敌对怪物，按其最大生命积累永久伤害；默认每级最多+20，进度保存在工具上。
superheavy: +1.5 melee damage/level, -15% attack speed/level and -10% mining speed/level (max -40%).
每级近战伤害增加1.5，攻速降低15%、采掘速度降低10%（采掘惩罚最高40%）。
tantrum: Melee damage fluctuates from 85% to 135%; charged hits may grant brief Strength I.
近战伤害在85%至135%之间波动；满蓄力命中可能短暂获得力量I。
unstable: 近战伤害在75%至125%之间波动。
whirl: +0.25 knockback/level; charged hits grant 2 seconds of Speed I.
每级击退增加0.25；满蓄力近战获得2秒速度I。
taiga_alien: +10% durability and +0.5 mining speed per level.
每级耐久增加10%，采掘速度增加0.5。
taiga_crumbling: 有效采掘速度每级增加15%。
